player_prompt.intro:
You are playing 2048 on a {board_size}x{board_size} board. Your goal is to reach a {target_tile} tile by sliding identical numbers together!
Valid moves: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Tiles combine when they collide, doubling their value.

invalid_move.no_change: Ɛlɛ, ɛgbɛyɛ taa ɛzʋtʋyaa tɩlɛɣzɩ. Paawɛɛ nɛ pɔɖɔŋ nʋmɔʋ kɩfalʋʋ nakʋyʋ yɔɔ.

outcome.win: Ɛyaa, ɛyʊ weyi ɛkpaɣ {target_tile}! Paya kɛlɛʊ {score}.
outcome.lose: Pɩlɩɣna tɩŋ kɛlɛʊ. Max tile {max_tile} - paya kɛlɛʊ {score}.
